_comment: What Jev reads about each option's model (policy.models[*].good_at/weak_at/cost), rewritten 2026-11-04 (brief item 12) from ~/effort-research/domain-benchmarks-2026-11-04.md (OpenRouter benchmarks and Artificial Analysis mirrors as of 2026-11-04), replacing the 2026-10-21 text that was wrong in places (muse-spark was described as weak at code and tools; the data makes it the strongest coder, web/UI builder and the most reliable on facts of the cheap models). Per model: its two to four strongest and one to three weakest domains in the table. Owner rules: every model handles Bahasa Indonesia; a score without an effort label is the model's highest effort. Rules, checked by descriptionProblems in lib/jev.mjs and test/profiles.test.mjs: no model names, no digits, no negations, no reference to another option. Cost word from the Go output price per 1M tokens: up to USD 0.25 cheapest (muse 0.20), up to 0.65 standard (mimo-v2.6-flash 0.28, glm-5.3-flash 0.50, gpt-6-luna 0.50, minimax-m3.1-flash 0.60, deepseek-v4.1-flash 0.60 off-peak / 1.20 peak), above that pricier (mimo-v2.6-pro 0.87, glm-5.3 4.40, kimi-k3.1-pro 10.00); beam-free is free. Readings used: deepseek GDPval 1746, AA-LCR 84.0, GPQA 87.9 | Omniscience -5.3, CritPt 14.3, Harvey 1.7. glm-5.3-flash GDPval 1773, ITBench 51.2, Cyber 49.9, Coding 71.5 | price on long cache-heavy chats (cached read 0.03 vs basis 0.006), Harvey 0.8. minimax AutomationBench 72.5, HLE 48.0, GPQA 87.6 | Omniscience -6.4, GDPval 1466, tau-bench 66.7. mimo-v2.6-flash tau-bench 77.9, SciCode 51.3 | Omniscience -10.8, GPQA 73.2, CritPt 12.0. gpt-6-luna AnalystAgent 43.8, Cyber 52.7, MLCR 26.1 | tau-bench 67.3, GDPval 1445. muse-spark-1.3 Omniscience 25.0, Harvey 8.9, CritPt 24.9, Coding 75.8, SciCode 58.8, Design Arena ~1340, tau3 50.5 | its time on every request. mimo-v2.6-pro AA-LCR 86.3, Cyber 56.1, HLE 49.4, CritPt 26.6, SciCode 60.9 | MLCR 12.8, GDP.pdf 19.2. glm-5.3 Coding 74.8, tau-bench 76.0, GDPval 1769, Briefcase 1504 | Cyber 36.4, Harvey 0.3, GDP.pdf 11.2. beam-free IFBench 79.6, GPQA 88.4 | GDPval 1177, Briefcase 976. kimi-k3.1-pro HLE 52.5, GDPval 1846, MMMU Pro 84.1, Cyber 64.1, GDP.pdf 31.4, MLCR 38.3 | AnalystAgent 38.8. muse-wonder is left out: no route dispatches it.
